question: Look for FDA safety communications about montelukast. Summarize only the returned notice titles or excerpts, link to them, and explain if full notice text was not retrieved. No personal treatment recommendations.
criteria: Safety notices, not recall substitution. No unsupported mechanisms or personal treatment instructions from memory. Disclose title-only or incomplete index evidence. Empty result not proof no safety notices exist.
answer:
**March 4, 2020**

“FDA requires Boxed Warning about serious mental health side effects for asthma and allergy drug montelukast (Singulair); advises restricting use for allergic rhinitis” [S2](https://www.fda.gov/drugs/drug-safety-communications/fda-requires-boxed-warning-about-serious-mental-health-side-effects-asthma-and-allergy-drug)

**Retrieval limitation:** The search returned this notice’s title and direct link, but not its full text. It searched the current FDA Drug Safety Communications index and did not search all historical alerts; therefore, the result is not necessarily exhaustive. [S1](https://www.fda.gov/drugs/drug-safety-and-availability/drug-safety-communications)
